data.long_description:
Nestled gracefully along the gentle curve of the Dubai Water Canal in the prestigious Al Wasl district, Eden House The Park offers more than just a home—it offers a curated lifestyle defined by intimacy, timeless sophistication, and understated prestige.

Comprising a collection of boutique low-rise buildings, this rare residential enclave is thoughtfully designed to harmonize with its surroundings. Residences are framed by lush landscaped gardens, shaded pedestrian walkways, and an architectural style that fuses modern minimalism with classic elegance. The result is a community that feels both exclusive and inviting—a sanctuary in the heart of the city.

Where Privacy Meets Connectivity

Eden House The Park is ideally positioned to offer both seclusion and convenience. Just moments from the cultural heart of Downtown Dubai, and a short distance from Jumeirah’s coastal charm, the development allows residents to enjoy the best of both worlds. Whether it's the energy of the city or the calm of canal-side promenades, everything is within effortless reach.

Design & Living Experience

Each residence is designed to maximize natural light, with floor-to-ceiling windows that invite the outside in. Interiors are finished with impeccable craftsmanship, featuring premium materials and thoughtfully curated details that reflect a deep respect for quality and timeless design.

Open-plan living spaces with a refined aesthetic
Seamless connection to verdant park views
Private terraces and balconies for quiet reflection
Select units with direct access to landscaped courtyards

A Subtle Celebration of Luxury

Eden House The Park is not a loud expression of luxury—it’s a subtle celebration of it. It’s for those who value privacy over publicity, craftsmanship over opulence, and legacy over trend. This is not just a residence; it’s a statement of lifestyle—discreet, distinguished, and deeply personal.

Key Highlights

Prime canal-front location in Al Wasl, one of Dubai’s most coveted neighborhoods
Boutique low-rise design with limited, exclusive residences
Landscaped gardens and shaded pathways throughout the community
Close proximity to Downtown Dubai, Jumeirah Beach, and key cultural landmarks
Designed for residents who seek elegance, serenity, and timeless value
